title: Quietly Quenched Kenyan Fennel Salad
description: A savory and aerated Kenyan dish featuring fennel bulb and bhuna, perfect for a light meal. This low-calorie-friendly salad is a great option for a healthy snack or lunch.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the thinly sliced fennel bulb and bhuna spice mix.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and olive oil.
Pour the lemon juice mixture over the fennel mixture and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh cilantro over the top of the salad.
Chill the salad in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in the crushed ice to aerate the salad.
Serve the salad immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
